sentences.text: 2 11-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P appearing on behalf of the State.
The petitioner is languishing in custody in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections341, 323, 498A, 365 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 /4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It is alleged by the informant that his daughter is traceless and there might be a possibility that her in- laws family members including the petitioner might have killed her.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is innocent and he has falsely Patna High Court CR.
MISC . No.49149 of 2023(2) dt.11-08-2023 been implicated in this case.
The petitioner is brother-in- law of the victim and he had no concern with the day- do-day affairs of the victim and her husband.
The petitioner lives separately from the husband of the deceased.
The petitioner is languishing in custody since 08.11.2022.

Considering the facts aforesaid and the period under custody, let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousands) with two sureties of the Dipak Kumar @ Dipak Kumar Pauddar vs The State Of Bihar on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156772716/
